project.name: design-requirement-checker
project.description: A local desktop application checks engineering DOCX requirements against an engineer-maintained checklist and presents deterministic results with source evidence for human review.

layers.name: Qt review workspace
layers.description: Presents import, checklist editing and evidence review in Qt. The window and workers coordinate operation generations, cancellation and safe thread cleanup.

layers.name: Application and startup
layers.description: Starts the desktop process, wires Qt to the use cases, and translates import, verification and baseline outcomes into values the UI can present.

layers.name: Domain and matching
layers.description: Defines immutable document and evidence values and the pure rules for phrase detection, source spans, strike classification and description comparison.

layers.name: DOCX ingestion
layers.description: Reads OOXML through the DOCX adapter into a document snapshot and records excluded structures and unresolved formatting alongside the extracted text.

layers.name: Baseline persistence
layers.description: Stores one versioned local JSON baseline and recovers it from a backup while keeping schema incompatibility visible to callers.

layers.name: Tests and experimental probes
layers.description: Exercises application behavior with deterministic synthetic documents, independent expected outcomes, Qt lifecycle tests and isolated exploration of matching and storage policies.

layers.name: Historical evaluation tools
layers.description: Defines the labelled manifest, evaluation command, metrics and reports for historical verification. Example data describes the format and the proposal records pending release criteria.

layers.name: Historical UI prototype
layers.description: Groups the browser mock, sample outcomes and associated design references used to inform the desktop interface.

layers.name: Packaging and developer tooling
layers.description: Configures the Python build, type marker, analysis tool and cross-platform CI. Windows workflows create the application distribution and offline developer bundle.

layers.name: Project guidance
layers.description: Explains the product, governing engineering rules, implementation milestones and task status through the README, agent manual and canonical documentation.

tour.title: What engineers review
tour.description: Start with the README’s demo workflow. An engineer maintains a checklist, imports a local Word document and inspects the evidence behind each result. The constitution explains which decisions belong to the checker and which require engineering judgment.

tour.title: Follow desktop startup
tour.description: Open the package entry point to see how it creates the Qt application, loads the local baseline and opens the review window. Trace the import and verification operations into application.py, where failures become outcomes the window can display.

tour.title: Read a Word document
tour.description: Follow an import into the DOCX adapter. It converts paragraphs, table cells and run formatting into a snapshot with source locations. In the adapter tests, compare the expected locations and strike states with the warnings produced by unsupported structures.

tour.title: Classify the evidence
tour.description: Follow a detection phrase or alias through matching.py to its span in the original text. The matcher retains qualifying occurrences, considers strike formatting and compares the description separately. Inspect the changed-value test to see how an item can be configured while its description differs.

tour.title: Inspect a current result
tour.description: Trace a worker completion into the main window, where the engineer can select evidence and inspect its source context. Follow the generation and snapshot checks to see what happens when the document or checklist changes during verification. The Qt tests exercise stale completions, cancellation and closing with workers active.

tour.title: Edit and save checklists
tour.description: Follow an edit from the item dialog to the checklist’s working copy and its save handler. Existing item and alias IDs carry through edits, and the store replaces the local JSON baseline atomically. Compare the tests for recovering a corrupt primary with those for protecting a baseline written under an unsupported schema.

tour.title: Interpret validation evidence
tour.description: The fixture factory creates DOCX packages for repeatable regression tests. The historical evaluator instead needs independent human labels for real or sanitized documents. Compare its example label with the validation README to see why the project has test results but no measured historical accuracy.

tour.title: Follow the Windows build
tour.description: The CI workflow runs source checks on macOS and Windows. The separate Windows build invokes PyInstaller on the same desktop entry point and uploads an onedir distribution. Open the engineering plan to locate the deferred clean-machine deployment checks.
